note: Auth is Bearer <access_token>, read from the browser session at sync time. userId is the numeric id in the message-box URLs. replyPath POSTs to the conversation endpoint to reply; contactPath POSTs {adId, message} to start a NEW conversation on an ad (the create-conversation API needs your display name as contacterName). Body shapes unverified until the first live send/contact. Run `probe --har <file>` to generate this.
